current_source_corroboration.source_excerpt: 2.1 If $|D_i|=0$, [F3] and [F4] make $\bigcup_{k\in\Lambda}(D_i+k)$ null. Every point of $E_i$ outside $H$ lies in one open tile, so periodicity gives $E_i\subseteq H\cup\bigcup_{k\in\Lambda}(D_i+k)$. By [F4] and [F5], $E_i$ is null; [F3] then makes $\Phi(E_i)=\widehat A_i$ null. This contradicts $A_i\cap\Omega\subseteq\widehat A_i$ and $|A_i|>0$ by [F6]. Thus $|D_i|>0$. Also $D_i\subseteq\Omega$, so [F5] and [F6] give $|D_i|\le\prod_j\ell_j<\infty$. [given, A1, F1, F3, F4, F5, F6, step 1.1, algebra]
